produces: Infinite mana creatures you control can produce
Infinite untap of creatures you control
included.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Helm of the Host triggers, creating a token copy of Combat Celebrant with haste.
Declare the token Combat Celebrant as an attacker choosing to exert it as it attacks.
The Combat Celebrant copy triggers, untapping all other creature you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat.
included.prerequisites: Helm of the Host attached to Combat Celebrant.
